metadata.title: Antarctic Circumpolar Current
metadata.what_you_will_try: This is the coldest region. Can you hear how muffled it sounds next to the tropics, and when it is warmest?

timeline.accessibility_text: Mar 25, 2007: cold surface water averaging 7.0 degrees Celsius (from 2.9 to 17.1), with steady currents and some swirling eddies. You hear deep, muffled tones and steady pulses.
timeline.echo_callout: Antarctic Circumpolar Current. Each streak is a surface current, coloured from blue at 0 to red at 32 degrees. Listen as the year unfolds.
